name: Natalie Mygroh
source: Natalie is a girl with a somewhat dry personality who comes from a wealthy family. She ended up getting out of it, tired of following strict social norms and following the future that her mother had defined for her. She is capable of using magic, but she is bad at it. Instead, she is exceptionally good at making magical potions, which she does with a passion. The blue streak in her hair is caused by an accident while making a potion. No matter how much she cuts it off, it always grows back the same color.
